707614.name: Jagged Edge

707632.name: Burning Swings

707835.name: Mounted Reaver

712460.name: Greater Mark of Blaumeux
712460.desc: Mark nearby party and raid members with the power of Blaumeux, increasing their spell power by 62.

800081.name: Chainwhip
800081.desc: Swing a chain at an enemy dealing 12 + 35% AP Physical Damage and silencing them for 2 seconds, generating a large amount of threat. If you successfully interrupt an enemy, this will refund 20% of the cooldown.

800168.name: Skulltaker

800340.name: Meatsaw
800340.desc: Generates 2 Demonfire Quickly swing a massive blade at up to 5 nearby enemies, dealing 50% Weapon Damage plus 8 and applies Torn Flesh.

800341.name: Torn Flesh
800341.desc: Bleeding for 114.8 damage every 3 sec for 15 sec.

800606.name: Chain Grab
800606.desc: Hooks the nearest Demonfire Orb, bringing it to your position.

800702.name: Hellknight
800702.desc: For the next 15 seconds, any direct Physical Damage dealt will grant a stack of Champion of the Legion.

800997.name: Bloodied Blade
800997.desc: Melee Physical Damage dealt now generates a stack of Demon's Blood.

801001.name: Infernal Shield
801001.desc: Reduces damage taken by 10%. Lasts 0.05 sec for each stack consumed. While the shield holds, enemies who strike you will take Fire damage, scaling with each Demonfire stack consumed.

801002.name: Unleash Pestilence
801002.desc: Let out a terrifying howl, unleashing your and your Greater Imp's active Pestilence on nearby enemies to trigger a powerful effect.

801004.name: Hellstorm

801016.name: Infernal Strike
801016.desc: Generates 2 Demonfire Strike an enemy for 55% Weapon Damage plus 3 as Fire damage.

801036.name: Agonizing Inspiration
801036.desc: Reduces your Fire damage taken by 10%.

801039.name: Hellfire Blade
801039.desc: Deals Weapon Damage to the target, plus 5% of your Maximum Health as Fire damage.Deals additional Fire damage based on your Strength every 3 seconds for 12 seconds. Consumes all Hellfire stacks to increase the damage of this effect.

801042.name: Flay Corpse
801042.desc: Consume the target corpse, generating 20 Rage and then healing you and your summons for 4% maximum health every 1 sec for 5 sec. Once a corpse has been flayed, it cannot be flayed again. Cannot be used in combat. Only usable on Humanoids, Beasts, or Demons.

801052.name: Atrophy
801052.desc: Reduces movement speed of nearby enemies by 50% for 8 sec.

801053.name: Pestilence of Conquest
801053.desc: Emanate a pestilence, slowing the casting speed of all enemies within 12 yds by 10%. Unleash: Interrupts all enemy casts within 10 yds, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 2 sec.

801054.name: Pestilence of Death
801054.desc: Emanate a pestilence, increasing your critical damage by 10%.

801059.name: Flames of Xoroth
801059.desc: Burn up to 0 enemies in front of you for 31.333 Fire damage. Deals increased damage per Demonfire consumed.

801063.name: Suffuse
801063.desc: Embrace your mortal body, restoring 103 + 10% Stamina health every 3 sec, scaling with Stamina and defense rating. Lasts 3 sec for each Demonfire consumed.

801067.name: Imprison
801067.desc: Imprison a Demon for 30 sec (6 sec vs players), banishing them, preventing all action, and making them invulnerable to all spells and attacks. Can only affect 1 enemy at a time.

802344.name: Pestilence of Famine
802344.desc: Emanate a pestilence reducing the movement speed by 25% and attack speed of nearby enemies by 10%. Unleash: Reduces enemies' movement speed within 10 yds by 50% for 8 sec.

802581.name: Warbringer
802581.desc: Slam the ground, dealing 65% Weapon Damage plus 2 to nearby enemies, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec. Deals increased damage per Demonfire consumed.

802602.name: Doom
802602.desc: Transforms your Greater Imp into a Doomguard for 12 seconds. While transformed, your Doomguard deals 20% more damage, and its auto attacks ignite the target, dealing 10% of the damage dealt as Fire Damage over 6 seconds, stacking 6 times.

802610.name: Ascended Warlock
802610.desc: Your Skulltaker used with 6 stacks of Demonfire now reduces the cooldown of Doom by -5 seconds. In addition, while Doom is active, your Doomguard will now copy your Skulltaker, dealing reduced damage.

802613.name: Skulltaker (Doomguard)
802613.desc: Consumes Demonfire Strike an enemy, dealing 87.5 Shadowflame Damage and increasing your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec. Ignores immunities and resistances and increases damage the target takes from your Demonflare by 1% for 3 sec. Deals 40% increased damage per Demonfire consumed

802615.name: Fury of Xoroth
802615.desc: Infernal Strike now grants you a stack of Xorothian Fury, increasing the chance for your next Skulltaker within 10 seconds to critically strike by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks. Additionally, using Skulltaker with 6 stacks of Demonfire grants you Xorothian Rage, causing your next Infernal Strike within 10 seconds to be guaranteed to critically strike.

802617.name: Xorothian Fury
802617.desc: Your next Skulltaker has a 10% increased chance to critically strike, stacking 3 times, for 10 sec.

802618.name: Xorothian Rage
802618.desc: Your next Infernal Strike is guaranteed to critically strike.

802619.name: Into the Maw
802619.desc: Hellmaw causes a Hellfire Explosion at the end of its duration, dealing additional Fire damage to all nearby enemies within 5 yards equal to 50% of the periodic damage dealt over the duration.

802620.name: Hellfire Explosion
802620.desc: Hellmaw causes a Hellfire Explosion at the end of its duration, dealing additional Fire damage to all nearby enemies within 0 yards equal to 50% of the periodic damage dealt over the duration.

803185.name: Chains of Malice
803185.desc: Lock an enemy down with magical chains, stunning them and dragging them with you for 5 seconds. Every 1 sec, the enemy will suffer 48 Physical Damage. Enemies that cannot be stunned or rooted cannot be dragged.

803253.name: Pet Pestilence Remover
803253.desc: Let out a terrifying howl, unleashing your and your Greater Imp's active Pestilence on up to 0 nearby enemies to trigger a powerful effect, and increasing your damage dealt by 0% for 0.

803254.name: War Heal Pet
803254.desc: Let out a terrifying howl, unleashing your and your Greater Imp's active Pestilence on up to 0 nearby enemies to trigger a powerful effect, and increasing your damage dealt by 1% for 0.

803334.name: Melt
803334.desc: Incinerate an enemy with hellish flames, reducing their Armor by 4% per Demonfire consumed and increasing their damage taken from your Blade of Xoroth and Flames of Xoroth by 10% for 24 sec.

803667.name: Mark of Rivendare
803667.desc: Mark an ally with the guile of Rivendare increasing their Stamina by 32 and Frost Resistance by 25 for 30 min.

803671.name: Mark of Zeliek
803671.desc: Empower an ally with the mark of Zeliek, reducing their resource costs by 5% and increasing their Arcane Resistance by 60. Lasts 30 min.

803693.name: Pet Pestilence
803693.desc: Let out a terrifying howl, unleashing your and your Greater Imp's active Pestilence on up to 0 nearby enemies to trigger a powerful effect, and increasing your damage dealt by 0% for 0.

803731.name: Greater Mark of Zeliek
803731.desc: Empowers nearby party and raid members with the mark of Zeliek, reducing their resource costs by 5% and increasing their Arcane Resistance by 60. Lasts 30 min.

803889.name: Hellrider
803889.desc: Increases your melee haste, movement speed, and mounted movement speed by 10% for 10 sec. Duration and effectiveness increased by 20% per Demonfire consumed. Usable while mounted.

804010.name: Hellish Rebuke
804010.desc: Next time you take damage, unleash a blast of hellfire upon enemies within 0 yds of the attacker, dealing 326 Fire damage.

804070.name: Piercing Bolts
804070.desc: Causing Physical Damage to an enemy with your Crossbow Stance equipped will reduce the enemy's Armor by 0 for 15 sec, stacks up to 3 times. Your Critical Strikes will consume the effect to deal 0% increased Critical Strike bonus damage.

804162.name: Burning Light
804162.desc: Your Critical Strikes with Holy Damage Spells set the target ablaze with Burning Light, causing 0 Fire Damage over 9 sec.

804168.name: Hellbound Leash
804168.desc: Bind an enemy Demon up to level 202, forcing it to do your bidding for 5 min (8 sec vs players). While active, 20% of all damage it takes is redirected to you.

804174.name: Curse of Hel'nurath
804174.desc: Curse an enemy for 15 sec, increasing Fire Damage taken and their chance to be critically struck by FIre Damage by 3%.

804285.name: Oath of Defiance
804285.desc: Increases threat generated by 600%, causes you to generate 5 Rage when taking damage, and your block rating is increased by 15% of Strength. Reduces damage dealt by 0%.

804340.name: Imp Guards
804340.desc: Level 20 Passive Each Hellfire Imp now reduces your Physical Damage taken by 1%.

804353.name: Shieldgore
804353.desc: Generates 2 Demonfire Gore the target with your spiked shield, causing 23 High Threat Fire Damage, scaling with your block value, and applying Torn Flesh to them.

804354.name: Black Skull Shield
804354.desc: Reduces the Rage cost of Shieldgore by -5 and increases its damage by 25%.

804683.name: Hell's Forge
804683.desc: Create a Blacksmithing Forge and an Anvil at your location for 2 min.

804702.name: Dreadrider's Stomp
804702.desc: Command your steed to stomp, dealing 638 Flamestrike Damage to nearby enemies. Damage increased by 25% for each stack of Path of Hellfire you have.

804703.name: Xorothian Warsteed
804703.desc: Mount your Xorothian Warsteed, increasing movement speed by 20%. Generate Path of Hellfire if you haven't dealt or taken damage for 3 sec, stacking up to 2 times. This increases to 3 times at level 30 and 5 times at level 40. Can be used in combat and is castable while moving.

804704.name: Hellfire Trample
804704.desc: Your Warsteed surges forward 25 yds and deals 18 Fire damage to enemies in your path. Gains 25% increased damage for every stack of Path of Hellfire you have.

804773.name: Drag Through Hell
804773.desc: Summons a friendly party or raid member to your location from anywhere in the world.

804774.name: Dreadsteed Portal
804774.desc: Summon a Dreadsteed Portal for 1 min. Allies can interact with the portal to mount a Dreadsteed.

804785.name: Hellfire Stirrups
804785.desc: Increases the mount speed of Xorothian Warsteed by 75% for 5 sec. While active, you cannot lose your Path of Hellfire stacks. Cannot be used in combat.

804787.name: Path of Hellfire
804787.desc: Mounted speed increased by 20%. When you take damage, you begin Losing Momentum, removing all stacks after a 2 sec delay.

804788.name: Hellfire Advance
804788.desc: Your Warsteed launches forward 30 yds. Distance scales with Path of Hellfire stacks. Cannot be used in combat.

804879.name: Legion's Presence
804879.desc: Emanate an aura to allies within 25 yds for 15 seconds, increasing their damage dealt by 10%. Fire Damage dealt by Hellfire Imps is increased by 150% and total health increased by 50% while this effect is active on them.

804880.name: Create: Hellgate
804880.desc: Consumes 1 Demonfire You open a Hellgate for 20 seconds. While within 8 yd of it you take 5% reduced damage and may generate a stack of Demonfire when you take damage. @ext:@All threat generated by the Hellgate is redirected to you.@:ext@

804883.name: Call: Hellfire Imp
804883.desc: Generates 2 Demonfire Beckon 1 Hellfire Imp to aid you in battle for 15 sec and generate 20 Rage. Threat generated by Hellfire Imps is transferred to you.

804947.name: Screamin' Demon
804947.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Unleash Pestilence by -15 sec.

805074.name: Call: Hellfire Abyssal
805074.desc: Call down a Hellfire Abyssal from the sky to crash down upon the targeted 8 yd area, dealing 1500 + 100% SP + 100% AP Fire Damage. The abyssal remains to aid you in battle for 15 seconds and emits an aura that reduces the damage taken by party and raid members within 40 yds by -5%. Costs -15 less Rage for each active Hellfire Imp.

805555.name: Gore
805555.desc: 2 Charges, 8 sec recharge Generates 1 Demonfire Gore an enemy, dealing 85% Weapon Damage plus 15.

805597.name: Greater Demon's Might
805597.desc: Empowers nearby allies, increasing their Strength by 5% for 30 min.

805664.name: Unseal
805664.desc: Deals 260 to 265 Shadow Damage to an enemy and increases the initial damage they take from your next Demonflare by 0%.

805665.name: Blade of Xoroth
805665.desc: Consumes Deathfire Stacks Strike an enemy, dealing 149 Shadowflame Damage and increasing your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec. Ignores immunities and resistances and increases damage the target takes from your Demonflare by 20% for 3 sec. Deals 40% increased damage per Deathfire consumed

805666.name: Seeking Pain

805667.name: Bringer of Fire

805668.name: Demonfury

805679.name: Black Shield
805679.desc: Consume all of your Demon's Blood stacks to create a demonic shield that absorbs 860 damage, increased by 20% per Demon's Blood stack, for 30 seconds.

805692.name: Cataclysmic Power
805692.desc: Your Calamity spell is now Instant.

805695.name: Mutilation
805695.desc: Increases the damage of Gore and Infernal Strike by 10%.

805697.name: Inferno Blast
805697.desc: Increases your critical damage against Burning targets by 20%.

805698.name: Inferno Blade
805698.desc: Increases the effectiveness of Firemaw by 15% and damage dealt by Firemaw now reduces the cooldown of Burning Scripture by 2 sec.

805699.name: Hellion
805699.desc: Reduces the remaining cooldown of your Calamity spell by 2 sec.

805700.name: Smolder
805700.desc: Dealing direct Fire Damage now ignites targets, Burning them for an additional 0 Fire Damage over 4 sec.

805703.name: Brimstone Splinters
805703.desc: Grants Seeking Flame a 30% chance to generate 1 additional Demonfire when it deals damage. Chance to trigger is increased by 5% for each Demonfire you have active.

805704.name: Flameforger
805704.desc: Increases your maximum Demonfire stacks by 3.

805705.name: Spite
805705.desc: Increases the duration of Burning Scripture by 5 sec.

805791.name: Warpath
805791.desc: Consumes your Demonfire stacks to Enrage, boosting your Movement Speed by 0%, Attack Power by 0%, and Critical Strike Chance by 0% for 3 sec, plus an additional 3 sec for each stack of Demonfire consumed. While this is active, your Movement Speed cannot be reduced below 100%.

806964.name: Meatsaw Rage/DF Gen
806964.desc: Each target hit by Warbringer increases your Strength and your movement speed by 1%, stacking 8 times, for 8 sec.

806965.name: Hellmaw
806965.desc: Burn an enemy with a fiery strike, dealing 18 + 10% AP + 18% SP Shadowflame Damage, plus an additional 72 + 24% AP + 57.2% SP over 12 seconds. Deals 20% increased damage per Demonfire consumed.

807144.name: Brimstone Striker
807144.desc: Damage dealt by Hellish Rebuke now reduces the cooldown of Sever and Juggernaut by -1 sec.

807247.name: Hellbound Charge
807247.desc: 2 Charges, 60 sec recharge Briefly jump atop your Xorothian Warsteed, increasing your movement speed by 70% for 3 seconds. Usable while indoors, but you cannot use your Mounted Combat abilities while riding your Warsteed in this way.

807336.name: Demolisher
807336.desc: Casting Flesh Hook or Chainwhip now taunts the target for 2 seconds and reduces your Physical Damage taken by -5% for 10 seconds.

807383.name: Battlestrider

807522.name: Demolished
807522.desc: Casting Flesh Hook or Chainwhip now taunts the target for 2 sec and reduces all damage you take by 10% for 4 sec.

807669.name: Hellfire Embers
807669.desc: Increases the Fire Damage dealt by your Hellfire Imp by 30% against enemies above 80% maximum health.

807671.name: Brimstone Flames
807671.desc: Damage dealt by Seeking Flame is increased by 15% on enemies affected by Pestilence of Apocalypse. Damage dealt is increased by an additional 2% for each Demonfire you have active.

807730.name: Demonic Power

887038.name: CoA Aura - Knight of Xoroth - Hellfire

887039.name: CoA Aura - Knight of Xoroth - Defiance
